title: Add feedback-loop-first section to expertise debugging.md
action: Add one additive section 'Build the feedback loop first' to .bee/expertise/debugging.md, placed before the existing hypothesis material, and add its row to the file's routing table. Content per CONTEXT.md D3, adapted from /home/thanhsmind/projects/AI/mattpocock-skill/skills/engineering/diagnosing-bugs/SKILL.md (read it; rewrite in this file's trigger/move/example voice, never copy): (1) before any hypothesis, build a repeatable command that can show the failure — ranked construction ladder: failing test > direct HTTP call > CLI run diffed against a fixture > replaying a captured trace > throwaway harness > property/fuzz loop over random inputs > bisection harness (git bisect run) > differential run against a known-good version > human-in-the-loop script only when a human step is unavoidable; (2) loop quality bar: red-capable, deterministic, seconds not minutes, runnable by the agent alone; (3) hard gate — no red-capable command, no hypothesis work; caught reading code to build a theory first: stop and build the loop; genuinely cannot build one: say so explicitly instead of proceeding; (4) flaky bugs: the target is reproduction rate, not a clean repro — run the loop many times, raise the rate until debuggable; a 1% repro is not a loop yet; (5) tag every temporary probe with one unique prefix like [DEBUG-a4f2] so cleanup is a single grep; the existing cleanup section gains that grep as its mechanism. Do NOT restate reproduce-first or hypothesis-template content that the file already has — link to those sections instead.
goal: Debugging craft gains the loop-construction ladder and the no-loop-no-hypothesis gate the current file lacks.
verify: commands.test green (PATH cargo test --release); new section in file voice; no duplication of existing sections.
